name: contact

from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import sys
directory = Path(sys.argv[1])
sheet = Image.new("RGB", (1040, 690), "#ddd")
for index, path in enumerate(sorted(directory.glob("page-*.png"))):
    page = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
    page.thumbnail((250, 330))
    sheet.paste(page, ((index % 4)*260+5, (index // 4)*345+5))
sheet.save(directory/"contact.png")
